subject: Access onboarding: SSO/SCIM ramp, IP guardrails & service account plan
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Sara Ortiz <sara.ortiz@lighthousehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Access onboarding: SSO/SCIM ramp, IP guardrails & service account plan

Sara —

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Per our call, attached is a proposed kickoff plan to get SSO (SAML) + SCIM provisioning live for Lighthouse Health while we put conservative IP guardrails and service-account roles in place. High-level asks from your side: SAML metadata + IdP contact, SCIM admin user to test provisioning, and the list of public egress IP ranges you must permit for the cutover.

Proposed 3-week ramp (we can compress):
- Week 0: Exchange SAML metadata, validate ACS/EntityID, create test SP in staging
- Week 1: SCIM provisioning smoke tests with sample user set; create service account patterns for automation
- Week 2: Canary cutover (10% users), monitor token refresh & audit logs, expand to full go-live

Critical items we need before a canary:
1) SAML metadata (IdP signed cert, entityID, ACS URL)
2) SCIM admin account + sample user CSV (10 users)
3) IP ranges for your firewall (we recommend allowing our staging and prod egress blocks listed in the attached doc)
4) Decision on whether service accounts for automated provisioning will be scoped to org-level or project-level (we recommend org-level for now)

I've looped in Monica (CS lead) and Ben (implementation eng) to coordinate the timeline and technical handoff. If this looks good, can you confirm a kickoff on Tuesday 8/10 at 10am PT?

Thanks,
Priyom
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: lighthouse_sso_requirements.pdf, lighthouse_saml_metadata.xml, onboarding_ramp_timeline.xlsx

Priyom —

Thanks — Tuesday 8/10 10am PT works. We've pulled the SAML metadata and I'll attach the config file to this thread after our admin signs it. On SCIM: we can provide a SCIM admin user for testing; we will send a 10-user CSV (test accounts) by EOD tomorrow.

IP ranges: we need to cross-check with our network team but preliminary: allow 35.201.10.0/24 and 34.72.55.0/24 for staging, and 35.201.20.0/24 for prod. I'll confirm formally in the kickoff.

Procurement is cc'd for the contract milestone alignment (we need the implementation SLA and completion date for internal approval).

—Sara
Head of IT Operations
Lighthouse Health

Subject: Re: Access onboarding: SSO/SCIM ramp, IP guardrails & service account plan

Team — quick internal alignment notes after the kickoff today:

Summary from 8/10 kickoff (10:00am PT) with Lighthouse Health:
- SSO: They will send signed SAML metadata and IdP contact by EOD 8/10. We validated ACS URL and EntityID in staging during the call.
- SCIM: Lighthouse will provide a SCIM admin account and 10 test users on 8/10-8/11. We will run provisioning in staging and validate mapping (email, displayName, group membership).
- IP allowlist: Lighthouse prelim list matches what Sara mentioned; we flagged we need exact egress endpoints for our prod pool.
- Service accounts: Lighthouse prefers org-level service account for provisioning automation; Ben to propose least-privilege roles.
- Audit & retention: Lighthouse asked for 90-day auth logs export and confirmation on access revocation flow for disabled SCIM users.

Action items (owners / dates):
- Ben: provide proposed IAM role mapping for the org-level service account and a minimal policy (ETA 8/11) [ben_carter]
- Priyom: share a step-by-step staging playbook and test checklist; include rollback steps for canary (ETA 8/11) [priyom_das]
- Marissa: coordinate procurement milestone text and support SSO security questions (ETA 8/12) [marissa_cole]
- Lighthouse: send SAML metadata + SCIM admin + IP confirmation (ETA 8/10-8/11) [Sara]

Notes on technical constraints:
- We recommended not enabling provisioning for users with nested group-based entitlements until after canary (manual provisioning for those cases).
- We will create a dedicated service account that will be pinned to the org; token rotation window will be 30 days by default unless their security team requests otherwise.

I'll upload Ben's role proposal and my staging checklist to the Drive link once ready.

Thanks,
Monica
Senior CS Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sara Ortiz <sara.ortiz@lighthousehealth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 16:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Access onboarding: SSO/SCIM ramp, IP guardrails & service account plan

Sara / team —

Following Monica's summary, attached is the minimal IAM role mapping for the org-level service account and the staging playbook we ran in our sandbox. Key technical points:
- Service account roles: SCIM:read, SCIM:write (scoped), Audit:read-only for troubleshooting, No admin console privileges. Example principal: svc-lh-scim@redwood-automation.
- IP checks: we will perform a connectivity test from our staging egress (35.201.10.0/24) to your ACS URL and confirm TLS handshake & cert chain.
- Canary plan: 10% user set (as defined in your CSV), 48-hour monitoring with automated rollback on auth-failure rate > 1.5% or SCIM delta errors > 0.5%.
- Audit export: We'll provide daily auth logs for the 90-day window requested; these will be delivered via S3 link and we will share an ingestion sample.

Next steps: Sara, once you share the signed SAML metadata and SCIM admin creds we will schedule the staging provisioning (target: 8/13 09:00 PT). Marissa — let me know the procurement milestone text and I will confirm the implementation acceptance criteria.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Implementation Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed_service_account_policy.json, staging_playbook.md
